recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, waist-up studio portrait of a man with long hair and visible arm tattoos, wearing a plain white t-shirt against a solid matte black background, topped with a wide-tracked sans-serif display name.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the bright white t-shirt and the deep black background
Symmetrical balance with the subject centered vertically and horizontally
Textual header framing the top edge of the composition
Direct eye contact creating a personal connection with the viewer
coreInvariants: Solid black background without texture or gradient
Arms crossed at the waist level
Wide letter spacing in the header text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, waist-up framing, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, positioned in the upper third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the wide-tracked text at the top, moves down to the face, then follows the crossed arms and tattoos.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial black negative space surrounding the head and shoulders to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (T-shirt and Text) for high visibility and clean lines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and grayscale tattoo ink for organic detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white shirt and black backdrop.

composition.scale: Small relative to width, spanning nearly the full width of the canvas

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum minimalist impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure and professional weight.
Open geometric forms that handle wide tracking well.
Classic geometric proportions for a timeless look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with mid-length brown hair and a light beard, wearing a plain white t-shirt, arms crossed showing detailed black and grey tattoos. The background is a flat, solid matte black. Lighting is soft and even on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the artist name in all-caps white geometric sans-serif font at the very top of the frame. Apply extreme tracking so the text spans approximately 90% of the image width.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and tracked widely?
Is the background pure black without noise?
Is the t-shirt bright white and high-contrast?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not touch the subject's head.
Verify the white of the shirt is not blown out, retaining fabric detail.
Check that the tracking is consistent across all letters.
Confirm the background is a uniform black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + solid black background + white minimalist clothing + wide-tracked geometric sans-serif header.
